purpose: Verify the default MESH callback projects valid face boundaries and standalone explicit edges to legacy addPolyline/addLine consumers without duplicate edges, source identity copying, or malformed topology delivery.

implementation.projection: one closed 3D POLYLINE per face with at least three vertices and all indices in range; valid explicit edges not covered by valid faces are delivered as 3D LINE callbacks, with undirected duplicates suppressed
implementation.coordinates: vertex XYZ copied to polyline vertex basePoint
implementation.identity: handle, parent handle, reactors, XDATA, and other source identity/ownership metadata are not copied

validation.ctestResult: PASS, 1/1, fallback checks include face-edge suppression, standalone-edge delivery, duplicate suppression, and malformed-edge omission

scopeLimit: Default legacy-consumer base-cage wireframe delivery only. This does not preserve crease values, subdivision, property overrides, native MESH construction, subdivision-surface fidelity, independent interoperability, DWG producer semantics, or broad MESH support.
claimEffect: No format or native-consumer support claim changes.
